text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп doesn't look well, so I take
her to the
infirmary to get some rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Your Radiant Eminence! Oh, our dear
gracious
leader, you've finally awoken!
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text: Okay, no way this isn't a dream!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
How did you—I-I-I mean, I assure you
that this is
no illusion!
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
Nah, this is a dream, for sure! Well, if
that's the
case...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm waking up because this is one boring
dream!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! W-wait, Your Magnificence! You
can make
anything happen in a dream!
Think how fun that
will be!
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
So what? Everything in real life already
goes
exactly as I plan!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: There's only one thing that doesn't—races!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Wh-why is there suddenly a dramatic
sunset?!
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
Boredom has haunted me as far as I can

remember. My life was a constant search
for new
thrills that never lasted.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
That all changed the first time I ran in a
race.
Racing is really something else...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Things never go the way you expect,
and no two
races are ever the same!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And it's all because every racer at the
starting line
runs with their whole heart
and soul...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Your Majesty...
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'll take reality over any dream!
Time to
rise and shine! Self-inflicted
thunder SHOOOCK!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Argh?!
text_block_list.name: Man B

text_block_list.text: Gah!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was one good thunder shock,
if I say
so myself.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Huh, I had no idea I loved racing that
much.
Doing a Golshi Memorial Cup
might be fun!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Your Radiant Eminence! Oh, our dear
gracious
leader, you've finally awoken!
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
Guh?! Another dream?! Self-inflicted
thunder
shock part TWOOO!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Your Radiant Eminence! Oh, our dear
graciou—
text_block_list.name: Man A

text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding me! Wake up,
wake up,
WAKE UUUP!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... I think... I'm finally out...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Dang, I'm beat...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп leaves the infirmary with a
little extra
pep in her stЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп doesn't get nearly enough
rest to
recover.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
